modelingNotes: Manufacturer-authored datasheet hosted at RS distributor mirror. Exact order denotes the standalone contact block, not its operator or enclosure.
Terminal keys.1 and.2 preserve the visually reviewed schematic labels. No complete engraved numeric prefix or physical orientation is inferred.
Positive opening is specified by Siemens. The generic contact-nc symbol represents normal state only, not certification or actuator details.
The NC contact is switchable, not a fixed hardware link. Passive contact use is application-dependent; neither terminal is universally required.
Conditional ratings and screw torque are retained in research.md; no scalar supply voltage or universal switching-current rating is assigned.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both endpoints of the sole NC contact are modeled using Siemens schematic labels.1 and.2. Screw terminals accept conductors; multiple conductors at a terminal do not create additional independent terminals. No lamp, supply, PE, shield or communication connection belongs to this standalone block. Enclosure bonding is outside this type; full engraved numbering is not established. Partial because the diagram supplies endpoint placeholders but the full installed terminal markings remain unverified.
